clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked into the Mystic Ward of Ironforge, the Hall of Mysteries serves as the city's spiritual and scholarly heart for the arcane and the divine. Within its blue-lit interior, dwarven and gnomish practitioners study ancient texts, train in the mysteries of the Holy Light, and weave arcane enchantments far from the clang of the Great Forge.

Illuminated by a distinctive blue and purple luminescence, the Hall of Mysteries stands out starkly against the rest of Ironforge. While the city around it thrives on stone, iron, and heavy plate, the hall's five soaring pillars shelter scholars draped in soft, flowing robes. It bridges both arcane wizardry and holy devotion, serving as the headquarters for the dwarven priesthood and the Order of the Silver Hand within Khaz Modan. Here, young clerics and knights study holy texts like the Tome of Divinity and receive guidance before their journeys carry them onward to Stormwind's Cathedral of Light.
